sloka: एवम् संबोधितः तेन शोकोपहत चेतनः ।त्य्ज्य शोकम् च मोहम् च रामो धैर्यम् उपागमत् ॥४-१-१२४॥
transliteration: evam saṁbodhitaḥ tena śokopahata cetanaḥ ।tyjya śokam ca moham ca rāmo dhairyam upāgamat ॥4-1-124॥

translations.english: Thus persuaded by Lakshmana, Rama who was hitherto besieged by grief and delusion, could set them aside and regain patience.
